methods.label: Track the successive squares
methods.explanation:
Each press squares the current display, so calculate the displays in order:
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{Press 1:}\quad&2^2=4,\\
\text{Press 2:}\quad&4^2=16,\\
\text{Press 3:}\quad&16^2=256,\\
\text{Press 4:}\quad&256^2=65\,536.
\end{aligned}
\]
The starting display and the displays after the first three presses are all below \(500\). The fourth press produces a number greater than \(500\), so the required number is \(4\) presses, choice A.
